description: Prised out of Mosscairn rubble and Rimeshard ice alike: one six-sided white point ringed with chippings.
lore: Quartz is the don't-know bin. Everything else on the sorting bench announces where it came from — a tooth is a jaw, a hide is a back, a green crust is a road somebody can name — and quartz comes off five different creatures identically, so the moment it is off the animal it is off the record.

Which is why apprentices are set to sell it. There is no price to ruin. What they are actually being taught, over a year of being told no, is the thing that runs [[lore/the_hard_pieces|the whole trade]]: people are not buying stone, they are buying the story fastened to it, and a white six-sided point with no story attached is the hardest sale in the sheds. The day one of them manages it, the master buys the drink.
